description: CAS service/ticket-granting tickets — single-use, short TTL, same CSPRNG-hash-store pattern as OIDC's AuthorizationCode. System-managed — never reachable through the generic entity API.

ticketHash.description: SHA-256 of the raw opaque ticket (ST-... or TGT-...)

ticketType.description: "ST" (service ticket, single-use) or "TGT" (ticket-granting ticket, tracks the browser session)

service.description: The service URL this ticket was issued for — re-checked exact-match at /cas/serviceValidate
